notes.title: v1.33 Update
notes.notes:
v1.33 update - bugs, tweaks, adjustments and features:

[list]
[*] Further gameplay tweaks and balancing

[*] Added checkpoints to Daturaland level

[*] Further adjusted controller l-stick deadzoning to make player rotation smoother

[*] Added a dynamic health bar indicator to all non-boss enemies

[*] Fixed bug in Village 2 where some militia were not chasing player when entering village area

[*] Updated retreat logic for Spetz and Grunts - they now check if player is close to selected retreat point and choose an alternate one if they are

[*] Added new keyboard input info/help screen

[*] Further tweaked main menu color and background image to make it easier to visually navigate 

[*] Adjusted amount of damage Molotov's can now do to BTR60's

[*] Molotov's can now damage helicopter boss

[*] Changed Datura mode update to fixed time update 

[*] Fixed bug where special mode of datura mode was ending a few seconds prematurely 

[*] Fixed bug where game did not pause and show relevant input method help if input method was changed during the game 

[*] Fixed bug where special datura effect did not resume after un-pausing game 

[*] Aiming reticule lock-on is now reset and set to invisible if player dies while aiming

[*] Fixed bug where combat music starts playing during camera spline intro 

[*] Fixed bug in City_2_1 and City_2_2 where damage indicator was not showing up for chaser-type BTR60's 
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.03
notes.notes:
V1.03 Update Notes:

Fixed major bug in tank levels where tank was not firing properly.

Tunnels: Minor level adjustments.

notes.title: v1.02 Update
notes.notes:
Updates and fixes for V1.02: 

Trainyard Helicopter Boss: - Re-wrote helicopter boss AI logic to make it more exciting, compatible with updated player auto aiming, and to prevent player cheesing behaviour. 

Bug fix - If player auto-locks onto an enemy and the enemy goes out of locking range, the aimer is still red.

Bug fix - If player starts aiming when no enemies are in range, and an enemy gets into range, the auto aiming locks onto the nearest enemy, but the player is no able to cycle additional enemies in range without breaking aim first and re-aiming. 

Removed accuracy modifier from RPG that sometimes causes the RPG rocket to explode at the player when instantiated for firing. 

Re-configured the level layout for Train 2 for improved NPC pathfinding and environment navigation.

Forest 1: Player can now shoot through wooden panels of sniper towers.

City 1_1: Instructions - changed instructions "use cover" to "stand behind cars and other objects to avoid getting shot" 

Spetz: Make turret/sniper spetz no longer shoots back immediately after being shot - minor random range delay is introduced.

notes.title: Update v1.01
notes.notes:
[b]Updates and Fixes[/b]

Controller: Player cannot look around while moving - this prevents some erratic behavior when using a controller.

Train 1: Locked Dragan in position until attacking mode is triggered - this prevents the player from being able to push him around. 

Train 1: If player walks away mid conversation with Dragan, he now attacks the player.

Fixed and improved talk trigger interactions with NPCs. 

Daturaland: Added interpolated rust/decay texture to collapsing platform upon trigger.

Train 1: Changed info box for health pickups to tell player they will automatically pickup items if their health is depleted.

notes.title: Full Access Release v1.0
notes.notes:
The full access version of Datura Time is finally here! After a little of more than four years in development, I am very happy to release the full version of my game! Hope you enjoy it!!

- Vlad

=======================================================================

Key changes:

	- New levels (29 in total)

	- New enemies, bosses and NPCs 

	- AI tweaks and improvement for old enemies 

	- A brand new vehicle combat mode

	- Improved camera motion

	- New music tracks

	- Extensive gameplay testing and rebalancing

	- Improved auto-aiming with ability to cycle between locked-on enemies
			
	- HUD/GUI tweaks & improvements

	- Weapon rebalancing and handling improvements

	- Environment interaction improvements

	- Btr60s can now be destroyed with all projectile weapons
 
	- Numerous performance improvements and bug fixes 

=======================================================================

notes.title: v0.9 Update - Last big update before work commences on finishing the game!
notes.notes:
- Players can now replay previous level 
- Fixed a number of small gameplay bugs
- Optimized gameplay
- Improved player control - e.g., player can carry on running after datura runs out
- Bunch of other level balancing tweaks

Important note: Due to the implementation of the new level saving/loading system, this update will erase all previously saved game progress!
